plastic.recommended_action: Empty the container and follow local plastic recycling rules.
plastic.safety: Do not recycle containers with unknown chemical contents without checking local guidance.

paper.recommended_action: Keep paper dry and separate from contaminated materials.
paper.safety: Avoid recycling paper contaminated with oil or unsuitable substances.

glass.recommended_action: Follow local glass collection rules and use a designated collection point where available.
glass.safety: Do not handle broken glass with bare hands.

metal.recommended_action: Separate accepted metal items and follow local recycling requirements.

battery.recommended_action: Keep batteries separate from ordinary household waste and take them to an appropriate battery collection point.
battery.collection_route: Battery collection point or authorized battery recycler
battery.safety: Do not dismantle, crush, puncture or burn batteries. Seek professional guidance for damaged, swollen or leaking batteries.

e_waste.recommended_action: Keep electronic waste separate from ordinary household waste and use an authorized e-waste collection facility or take-back program.
e_waste.safety: Do not burn or dismantle electronic waste without suitable training.

organic.recommended_action: Separate suitable food scraps for organic waste collection or composting where available.
organic.collection_route: Organic waste collection or composting facility
organic.safety: Store food waste properly to reduce pests and unpleasant odours.

general.recommended_action: Check whether the item is recyclable or hazardous before using general waste collection.
general.collection_route: Municipal general waste service, if accepted
general.safety: Do not assume unidentified waste, batteries or electronic waste are safe for ordinary disposal.
